title: Hot Dog Burnt Ends
steps: Score. Score a crosshatch pattern into each hot dog.
Season. Coat with yellow mustard as a binder, then cover generously with BBQ rub.
Cut and sauce. Cut each into quarters and put in a disposable foil pan with the butter, brown sugar and BBQ sauce; stir to coat.
Finish. Cover with foil and smoke another hour, uncovering halfway so the sauce thickens into a sticky glaze. Serve warm.
notes: Recipe fetched from the creator's linked page: burntpelletbbq.com/hot-dog-burnt-ends
